deep.rule: Never downgrade. Reserved for high-stakes architecture, security review, root-cause debugging, portfolio decisions, strategic command.

fast.rule: Default tier for builders, specialists, and dept VPs. Downgrade to haiku only if task volume is high + outcome can be verified with cheap heuristics.

cheap.rule: Back-office: high-volume, structured, auditable. Daily sweeps, registry computes, capability indexing.

downgradeRules.description: When monthly LLM spend > 110% of budget, downgrade non-critical sonnet runs to haiku
If a haiku agent fails >40% of runs in a week, temporarily upgrade to sonnet for 50 runs to validate the issue isn't model capability

enforcementModes.advisory: Log violations only, do not block dispatch
enforcementModes.warn: Log + emit warning event but allow run
enforcementModes.block: Refuse dispatch, return error to caller
